name: profile-porter
title: Profile Porter
description: Open links and sites in the right browser profile, with Profile Porter.
author: rahmakyan

commands.name: open-in-profile
commands.title: Open in Profile
commands.subtitle: Profile Porter
commands.description: Pick a browser profile and open a link in it. Without a link, the link on the clipboard, or just a window of the profile.

commands.name: open-link
commands.title: Open Link in the Right Profile
commands.subtitle: Profile Porter
commands.description: Hand a link to Profile Porter, which opens it in the profile you use that site in.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Sites and Pages
commands.subtitle: Profile Porter
commands.description: Show Profile Porter's panel with what you typed: the profile each site is used in, and the pages you visited.
